heroHeadline: Envoys Brief Zelensky in Dublin After Putin Talks; Largest POW Swap of the War Pending
heroSubtitle: After the Abu Dhabi round, Witkoff and Kushner met Putin on Nov 12, agreed a new round of talks without dates, and briefed Zelensky near Dublin. Europe’s seat at the table remains disputed.
